NBA.current_resolution: Schedule 2027 is canonical required weekly P5 source. Enrichment assets are auto-promoted when SportsDataverse publishes 2027 files.
NBA.reconciliation: Basketball-Reference operational reconciliation; ESPN Scoreboard cross-check; NBA.com official verification for discrepancies/OT/corrections
NBA.integrity: provider SHA-256 + size + nonempty schema/game-id coverage; immutable content-addressed snapshots
NBA.activation: Run svlActivateDataIngestion() once in the bound Apps Script project after syncing bridge files.

optional_unavailable: nhl_rosters/rosters_2027.* not published; CURRENT roster coverage uses game_rosters_2027
NHL.reconciliation: Hockey-Reference operational reconciliation; ESPN cross-check; NHL.com official verification
NHL.integrity: provider SHA-256 + size + nonempty schema/game-id coverage; immutable content-addressed snapshots
NHL.activation: Run svlActivateDataIngestion() once in the bound Apps Script project after syncing bridge files.

source.incremental_policy: WEEKLY_INCREMENTAL with 7-day correction overlap; first run bootstraps from July 1 of current season cycle
source.egress_note: Apps Script uses ESPN alternate host plus a non-browser User-Agent because browser-like headers/site.api may return 403 from Google egress.

Soccer.normalized_schema: SOCCER_EVENTS_CURRENT.json stores event_id, league, competition, date_utc, teams, status, regulation_90_home/away, post_regulation_home/away, penalty_shootout_home/away, ESPN final score, source metadata, official verification routing
Soccer.integrity: per league/date HTTP status + SHA-256 + size + event count; merged CURRENT content-addressed SHA snapshots; failures => INCOMPLETE; verification queue => PROVISIONAL_VALID
Soccer.activation: Run svlActivateDataIngestion() once in the bound central Bridge Apps Script after syncing the updated shared ingestion file and Soccer adapter.

ATP.role: Results Archive discovery + structured current-tournament results backend; daily trigger accumulates match results into CURRENT

WTA.role: Official tournament discovery + edition match results

Tennis.crosscheck: Flashscore Tennis Results by tournament/week — verification only, never primary ingestion
Tennis.normalized_schema: TENNIS_EVENTS_CURRENT.json: tour, tournament_id/name/location, provider_match_id, event_id, round_raw/normalized, player ids/names, winner_side, status, status_raw/detail, set_scores, start_utc, source metadata
Tennis.incremental_policy: 8-day overlap from prior cutoff; no weekly uploads. Shared daily trigger accumulates ATP live/current results and refreshes WTA tournament/match window.
Tennis.integrity: raw ATP/WTA CURRENT files + normalized CURRENT, content-addressed immutable SHA-256 snapshots, immutable run manifests, size/coverage/status
Tennis.activation: Shared trigger may run in degraded mode so healthy sports/WTA continue automatically while ATP remains source-blocked.
Tennis.atp_official_api_note: ATP ProTennisLive exposes official Results/Tournaments endpoints, but ATP documentation indicates data-feed tokens may be required. Do not treat that API as usable until a token is provisioned.

atp_structured_fallback.strategy: Prospectively capture stable ATP main-draw singles match IDs, then resolve those exact IDs individually after start/completion.
atp_structured_fallback.role: Structured operational fallback only when ATP Tour is blocked from Apps Script; ATP Tour remains official verification source.
atp_structured_fallback.free_tier_constraints: 100 requests/day; completed-list history is paid, so CURRENT must persist pre-start IDs and resolve them individually.
atp_structured_fallback.quota_guard: Max 90 Live Tennis API requests per ingestion run; fail closed rather than silently truncate.
atp_structured_fallback.scope_note: Do not server-filter by tier; provider may temporarily publish tier=null for newly discovered events. Enforce ATP singles main draw first, then reject known out-of-scope tiers locally.

activation_policy: svlActivateDataIngestion smoke-runs all configured sports; if at least one sport succeeds it installs/replaces the shared daily trigger and reports degraded=true when any sport is incomplete.

global_p5_layer.source_refresh_rule: Each sport refreshes only its declared sources. P5 reads CURRENT manifests; weekly uploads are not part of steady state.
global_p5_layer.readiness_contract: READY only when required sources and sport-specific coverage gates pass.
global_p5_layer.snapshot_dedup: svlStoreSource_ uses content-addressed SHA-256 snapshots and reuses an existing identical snapshot.

boundaries.odds: ODDS_ARCHIVE only when separately/prospectively used; ingestion does not request odds
